authority: test-only source-evidence representation and a bounded Lean projection; no production behavior, solver, HIR, syntax, fixture, dependency, lockfile, expected-output, or semantic change

identity_projection.operation_identity: compare SourceOperationId values directly with typed Eq in memory; do not use Debug, spelling, range, family label, or serialized text as identity

operation_ref.store: the exact owning HIR module's source_effect_declarations vector and nested operations vectors
operation_ref.validation: resolve each coordinate through that store, compare to the original typed ID, and check the finite mapping is injective over all referenced IDs

source_node_ref.store: the exact run-owned ParsedFile tree reached from its existing source owner
source_node_ref.validation: resolve the path using parse-owned SourceNode descent and compare the resulting key with the original SourceNodeKey; check uniqueness and ownership

identity_projection.rule: if the exact owning store or a faithful, injective reference cannot be established for any serialized operation, arm, or source coordinate without a new source path/dependency, stop before execution

required_typed_join: captured operation equals captured ResumeTemplate declaration by typed identity
consumer operation equals emitted request declaration by typed identity
consumer operation differs from captured operation by typed identity in this fixture
preserve: all R29 callback joins, request-owned observation snapshot, selected dynamic installation and actual callback/local Grant results
no Debug-formatted identity token appears in identity-sensitive JSON or mutation checks

required: complete frame projection in pop order
companion.rule: companion evidence cannot supply callback-entry, callback-use, request-observation, or Grant evidence

callback_required: wrong typed use or result view
mutations.rule: absent or unchanged targets do not pass; preserve every applicable R29/R28 required mutation

lean_projection.model: unchanged R26 CallbackHygieneCorrespondence at pinned SHA in the input manifest
target: only CatchReady premises justified by authenticated source records
actual callback/local Grant decision projected from same request-owned observation and source guard
lean_projection.history: derive only when every Step is justified by actual source transitions; otherwise leave open
